title: Zero-fuel docked watch: a scout already docked at Cargo Lanes Freight Depot (Nebula) saves its order book and mission board every 5 minutes for 30 minutes
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-23 23:16 UTC (orders ENT-084, block ORACLE: the newborns' home regions; rule F8). The newborn scouts of this region stand docked here between their region reads; this watch gives them zero-fuel work with an output: fresh book readings (bid and ask refill, table stats_refill) and the mission board for Trade and Logistics. A copy of watch-book-the-levy: one ship a station, since a second reads the same book; only a scout already in this system takes it (requires.in_system). Standing work, never judged on its pay (F22).
